Load the risk model and treatment-effect estimates

Source: R/model.R
mhspc_model.Rd

mhspc_model() reads the model specification, checks that it is internally consistent, and returns it as an mhspc_model object. The prediction functions call it by default, so most users never need to call it directly.

Usage

mhspc_model(path = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to a model specification file. The default, NULL, uses the specification installed with the package.

Value

An object of class mhspc_model.

Details

The specification contains only aggregate quantities: the risk-model coefficients and spline knots, the 4-year baseline cumulative hazards from the multiply imputed datasets, and the pooled treatment-effect curves.

Examples

mhspc_model()
#> mHSPC ARPI treatment-effect model (261002-raw-rcs)
#> • Baseline risk: All-cause death within 4 years with Placebo plus ADT.
#> • Inputs: ecog_ps, gleason_score, visceral_metastasis, bone_metastases, psa,
#>   hemoglobin, albumin, alp, and ldh.
#> • Treatment effects of ARPI plus ADT: survival difference, restricted mean
#>   survival time difference, and hazard ratio.
#> • Baseline hazards from 100 imputed datasets.
